question: Which PUBLIC measured datasets constrain the model in inputs/ (BT-HX-Q005 renal OCT2/MATE steady-state clearance)?
model_under_constraint: inputs/Q005_model.py; primary output CL_Cr (mL/min), secondary CL_Met (L/h); parameters K_OCT2_ref_uM, Jmax_OCT2_ref_pmol_cm2_min, f_u, P_MATE_cm_s, gfr_mL_min, area_cm2, kappa_creatinine, jmax_factor_creatinine, C_metformin_uM
frozen_rules: R1 stable URL resolved 200 in-session; R2 license read from the publisher or the file; R3 a nameable one-directional constraint path; R4 measured (not simulated/atlas/synthetic). See PREREG.md section 2.

sources.name: eICU Collaborative Research Database - demonstration subset (eicu-crd-demo) v2.0
sources.access: open to anyone, no registration, HTTP 200 verified in-session
sources.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0 (ODbL 1.0)
sources.license_evidence: read from the publisher content page in-session: 'Access Policy: Anyone can access the files, as long as they conform to the terms of the specified license. License (for files): Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0'
sources.size: 7,693,200 bytes downloaded (3 of 30 demo tables); whole demo is larger, full CRD is ~2.6 GB
sources.format: gzip-compressed CSV, 3 tables, no header metadata file
sources.subjects: measured, 1,841 unique de-identified patients / 2,520 ICU unit stays in the patient table; 2,414 adult (>=18 y) stays; 2,271 adult stays with serum creatinine; 2,091 survive the anthropometry plausibility window and enter the derived GFR/CG computation
sources.type: clinical time series (labs with minute offsets), anthropometry, measured fluid balance
sources.measured_quantity_of_interest: serum creatinine (14631 lab rows, 3 unit spellings of mg/dL), BUN, measured urine volumes, age, sex, admission weight and height

constrains.empirical_result: cohort median 71.04 mL/min/1.73 m2 (IQR 43.35-96.84, n=2091); 71.1% of stays fall inside the model's frozen 0.5-2.0 x 94.99 plausibility window; cohort CV 0.471 is 3.19x the prior CV 0.15

constrains.path: serum creatinine + weight + age + sex -> Cockcroft-Gault (mL/min) and a steady-state mass balance against measured urine flow
constrains.empirical_result: CG median 74.46 mL/min (IQR 44.39-109.85, n=2091); implied urine creatinine at the model's CL_Cr and measured flow has median 110.3 mg/dL

constrains.path: repeat serum creatinine within the first 24 h -> within-stay SD/mean
constrains.empirical_result: median within-stay CV 0.110 (IQR 0.061-0.194, n=1572 stays), i.e. 2.2x the frozen 0.05 residual

sources.why: no albumin and no metformin in the sample, and no transporter uptake, efflux, intracellular accumulation or imaging: a bedside steady-state endpoint cannot identify a saturable transport constant or a membrane permeability
sources.provenance: source (measured creatinine/urine/weight/age/sex) + derived (CKD-EPI 2021, Cockcroft-Gault, Du Bois de-indexing, steady-state mass balance) - see analyze_sample.py

sources.name: ChEMBL 37 - metformin x human OCT2 / MATE1 / MATE2-K bioactivity
sources.access: open REST API, HTTP 200 verified in-session
sources.license_evidence: read from https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/about/ in-session: 'The ChEMBL data is made available on a Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 3.0 Unported License'
sources.size: API response for the query above: 7 activity records; database 24,527,044 activities / 18,552 targets (db version ChEMBL_37, verified in-session via /status.json)
sources.format: JSON over REST (also bulk TSV/SQLite releases)
sources.subjects: in-vitro transporter assays, Homo sapiens targets; 2 of the 7 metformin records carry a numeric standard value

constrains.path: assay standard_type/standard_value -> inhibition IC50, not uptake Km/Vmax
constrains.empirical_result: OCT2 IC50 = 1700000 nM (assay CHEMBL2075996), MATE1 IC50 = 250000 nM (CHEMBL2320306), MATE2-K 1 record with no numeric value; 1 raw 'Drug uptake = 110.0 pmol/mg' (CHEMBL2427054)

constrains.path: the only numeric uptake record is normalised per mg protein, i.e. a different frame from the model's per-cm2-per-min surface-normalised value
constrains.empirical_result: confirms that the public record does NOT supply the model's frame; a tissue-surface conversion is needed and is itself unvalidated

sources.why_weak: inhibition IC50 against an expressed transporter is not the saturable uptake constant the model's Michaelis-Menten step needs; and N is 2 usable numeric records, so it cannot set a prior CV of 0.30 on a defensible spread

sources.name: Metrabase - measured transporter uptake/efflux kinetics
sources.access: FAILED in-session: 'Could not resolve host' (DNS) for both metrabase.ch and www.metrabase.ch
sources.license: OVERIFIERAD - not re-read from the publisher
sources.format: MITAB TSV per drug-transporter pair (documented; not confirmed here)
sources.note: on paper this is the single most on-target public resource for the model's two molecular parameters, and the reason the K/J anchor remains a one-study, CHO-cell, in-vitro value. It could not be verified from this sandbox and is therefore NOT used as a measured input.

sources.subjects: UNKNOWN - cycle total is documented as of order 1e4 adults, but the analysed subset size was NOT verified in-session and is not asserted
sources.verdict: CONSTRAINS-WEAK (registered, not exercised in this session)

constrains.model_target: f_u (leading molecular candidate, nominal 1.0, prior mean 0.95)
constrains.path: serum albumin -> plasma protein binding context for the metformin branch of f_u
constrains.empirical_result: NOT COMPUTED - the sample budget was spent on the eICU demo, so no albumin number is claimed

constrains.path: population-representative serum creatinine + demographics + CDC survey weights

sources.why_weak: an NHANES albumin concentration constrains the protein-binding context but is not a metformin unbound fraction; a population cross-section also cannot set a within-person prior CV

sources.name: Renal geometry imaging (TCIA collections, e.g. TCGA-KIRC; Visible Human Project)
constrains: area_cm2 (2.0e5 cm2, flagged 'geometric assumption' in inputs/Q005_RESULTS.md)
sources.note: a measured kidney volume from CT would attack the model's worst-sourced parameter, but converting a volume to an effective tubular exchange area requires an allometry that is itself not measured, so the expected verdict is CONSTRAINS-WEAK at best. Not verified here.
